rules.statement: A surviving spouse can alienate the property of the estate to pay debts.
rules.supporting_quote: It was laid down so long ago as the time of Chief Justice Sir Edward Creasy, that a surviving spouse can alienate the property of the estate to pay debts, and this decision has been followed in the case of Wijeratna v. Abeyweera ( 5 S. C. C. 70), in the case of Pasupathy Chettiar v. Cantar Pandary (8 S. C. C. 118 205), and in case of Hadjiar v. Hendrick Appu et al (2 N. L. R. 26),
